budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Bring all three crew members to x>=6 across two channels using four reusable parts and temporary spans.
task.natural_termination: All crew physically occupy far-bank ground simultaneously; otherwise truncate at tick 144. A previously arrived crew member may return to help, and arrival reward is not repeated.
task.interaction: Mass equals one plus carried part count. Unbraced spans carry mass one; braced spans carry mass two. The builder consumes a held part to install a span, the stabilizer sustains it, and the porter cannot cross while holding two parts. Consent-based handoffs and bridge recovery move exactly existing material identities.
task.observation_access: Map, roles, all part locations and owners, bridge support/lifetime/capacity and current crew locations are public. The acting role receives its identity one-hot. There are no private fields.
task.transition_order: Movement uses existing spans/capacities and rotating mass arbitration; pickup/drop and consent-based handoffs follow; support decays or is renewed; the builder installs or retrieves a span; unsupported lifetime decays; overload/expiry collapses return parts and affected crew to the western bank; arrivals and termination follow.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Number of collapsed spans over the episode
Number of crew falls with a deterministic recovery to the western bank

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
